We are looking for someone who can turn open-ended problems into structured solutions, explain what the data shows to colleagues who are not technical, and bridge technical and business perspectives.

Insights and Reporting
Become an expert in alternative investments and CAIS data, and use what you learn to deliver insights that tie marketing activity to advisor engagement and platform outcomes

Design and maintain dashboards and automated reports that give teams self-serve access to trends, patterns, and predictions

Apply machine learning and AI techniques (such as segmentation, propensity and predictive modeling, natural language processing, and generative AI) to improve targeting, personalization, and decision-making
Experiment with emerging AI tools, deliver proofs of concept for stakeholders, and create reusable documentation and training that share AI-powered practices across the team

Experience building dashboards and reports in a business intelligence tool (such as Tableau, Power BI, or Streamlit) or custom HTML reporting
Hands-on experience with marketing and CRM platform data (such as HubSpot or Salesforce) and an understanding of campaign, email, and event metrics
